skill.summary: Turn a 2-minute unedited vlog recording into 1080p AI-edited clips just by typing what you need. Whether it's editing videos using plain text prompts instead...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editing Video AI Prompt skill.
- Enables AI-powered video editing via plain text prompts — no manual timeline work needed.
- Supports uploading raw footage and describing desired edits; outputs 1080p clips in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic handling of session tokens, cloud rendering, and export.
- Supports common edit tasks: cutting pauses, adding BGM, title cards, format exports, and more.
- User-friendly error handling and guided workflows for creators and social media managers.
